newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares rebound on stronger dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares rebound on stronger dollar.

text.p: Hungarian share prices rebounded on Monday from Friday's lows on what dealers attributed to the dollar's strengthening.
The BUX index closed at 3,754.25 points, up 39.66.
"Due to the dollar's firming Hungarian share prices bounced back and moved in parallel with major markets," said Geza Raner of Bank Austria-GiroCredit Befektetesi Rt.
Shortly after the launch of the session prices settled at above Friday's closing levels and hovered in narrow ranges for the rest of the day, with a slightly stronger selling side.

"Sellers outnumbered buyers in the second part of the session and something similar can be expected for the rest of the month because several funds are likely to close their positions," one trader said.
On Monday chemicals company TVK 's shares were the most actively traded. TVK closed at 1,620 forints, up 35.
The day's gainers included the two pharmacueticals papers. Richter rose almost three percent or 250 forints to close at 8,830, while Egis ended at 8,750, up 165.
